title: [YouPass Collect] - City living survey comparison 1980 and 2010
prompt: The tables show results of 2 surveys done in 1980 and 2010 on various aspects of city living in a particular city. Units are measured in percentage. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The tables compare public satisfaction ratings across six aspects of city living in a particular city between 1980 and 2010, categorized as good, neither good nor bad, or bad.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, most aspects witnessed a decline in positive ratings over the 30-year period, with only education and employment showing improvements. Meanwhile, transport consistently received the lowest satisfaction ratings, while healthcare and education were the most favorably rated aspects in 1980 and 2010, respectively.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the most positively rated aspects in 1980, healthcare led with 82% of respondents giving it a good rating, while education and the environment were joint second at 72% each. By 2010, education had improved by 10 percentage points to 82%, becoming the highest-rated aspect and matching healthcare’s 1980 figure. In contrast, healthcare experienced a decline of 8 percentage points to 74%, while the environment saw only a marginal decrease of 1 percentage point to 71%.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the remaining aspects, in 1980, shops received good ratings from 64% of residents, marginally higher than employment at 62%, while transport lagged significantly behind at just 52%. Over the subsequent three decades, employment saw the most notable improvement, rising by 10 percentage points to 72%. Conversely, shops and transport both deteriorated, falling by 4 and 13 percentage points to 60% and 39%, respectively. Notably, transport recorded the sharpest decline among all aspects, with its "bad" rating also increasing from 32% to 38%.
